title: Physicists discover a hidden gluon structure inside protons that could rewrite textbooks
excerpt: Physicists may have uncovered a hidden feature inside protons that helps preserve one of matter’s most fundamental properties. RHIC collision data suggest baryon number is carried not simply by three quarks, but by a Y-shaped junction of the gluons connecting them. The finding challenges a decades-old textbook picture and could deepen our understanding of why protons—and ultimately matter itself—remain stable.
content_html:
New findings from the STAR detector at the Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider (RHIC) are challenging a familiar picture of what gives protons one of their defining quantum properties. The results suggest that gluons, the particles that act as the glue holding quarks together, may play a key role in carrying and conserving baryon number.

The evidence comes from high-energy particle collisions at RHIC, a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science user facility for nuclear physics research that operated at DOE's Brookhaven National Laboratory from 2000 to early 2026. According to the new study, published in Science, baryon number may be associated with a Y-shaped "junction" of gluons connecting the proton's three main quarks. If confirmed, that would challenge the long-standing assumption that baryon number belongs exclusively to those quarks.

"Traditionally, scientists have assumed that each of the three main 'valence' quarks inside a proton or neutron carries one-third of the baryon number," said Zhangbu Xu, a professor at Kent State University with a joint appointment at Brookhaven Lab.

A Decades-Old Idea About Gluons

Physicists first proposed the baryon junction, also called a gluon junction, in the 1970s as a way to describe how gluons connect the valence quarks inside a proton. In 1996, four years before RHIC began operating, Dmitri Kharzeev, a theoretical physicist at Stony Brook University and Brookhaven Lab, proposed that this junction might do something even more fundamental. Rather than the valence quarks carrying baryon number, the junction itself could be responsible.

The STAR collaboration has now developed a way to test that possibility using several types of collisions produced at RHIC.

"Using data collected from different types of particle collisions at RHIC, our results suggest that the baryon number is not simply carried by individual quarks," Xu added. "Our findings strongly support the idea that baryon number is more favorably carried and transported by gluons, the particles that hold quarks together, when arranged in this special configuration."

Why Baryon Number Matters

Determining what actually carries baryon number matters far beyond the internal structure of a proton. In RHIC collisions, conservation of baryon number means that the total number of baryons, three-quark particles such as protons and neutrons, must remain unchanged before and after the collision. The same conservation principle also applies on the scale of the universe.

"Since the Big Bang, the number of protons and neutrons all together never changes as a function of time," said Nicole Lewis, a STAR physicist at Rice University who started this project as a postdoc at Brookhaven Lab in 2020. "The reasons for this conservation are not well understood. It's one of the mysteries of the universe, related to why we have more matter than antimatter," she said.

Baryon number conservation also has a much more tangible consequence. It helps explain the extraordinary stability of protons, which form a central part of atomic nuclei and do not appear to decay under ordinary circumstances.

"It's believed that the lifetime of a proton is longer than the lifespan of the universe," Lewis said. "This allows atomic nuclei to form and be stable -- which means matter, as we interact with it in the universe, can exist."

A More Complicated Proton

The possibility that gluons carry baryon number would overturn the standard simplified description found in many textbooks. In that picture, a proton has a baryon number of plus one, divided equally among its three main valence quarks. Each quark therefore carries plus one third of the baryon number, much as the proton's electric charge is distributed among its three valence quarks.

But real protons are much more complicated than that simplified model suggests.

"In the naïve quark model, there are three quarks inside a proton, but nothing else," said Tommy Tsang, formerly a postdoc at Kent State University, now at DOE's Argonne National Laboratory. "But if we look at details inside, there are not only three quarks but also a lot of gluons interacting, connecting between those quarks, and there are also quarks and antiquarks that pop up from the vacuum, so it's actually a really complex object."

Quantum chromodynamics (QCD), the theory used to describe these interactions, has been highly successful in explaining the strong force that acts among quarks and gluons. Even so, models inspired by QCD often need additional assumptions to reproduce some of the particle patterns observed when RHIC smashes nuclei together at nearly the speed of light.

An Unexpected Excess of Baryons

One observation in particular caught the STAR team's attention. The detector repeatedly records more baryons than antibaryons emerging sideways from the collisions, perpendicular to the direction of the incoming beams.

"In the STAR detector, we consistently see an excess of baryons coming out of the collisions perpendicular to the direction of the colliding beams," Tsang said. "The fact that we end up with more baryons than antibaryons -- or more matter than antimatter -- is not surprising since our collisions start with matter," he said.

These extremely energetic collisions convert tremendous amounts of energy into thousands of newly created particles. What puzzled the researchers was not simply that more baryons than antibaryons were produced. It was where the excess baryons appeared.

If valence quarks alone carried the baryon number, explaining the excess away from the beamline would require all three valence quarks from one colliding proton to stop near the center of the detector. They would then have to undergo a conversion from matter into energy and back into matter, producing new baryons that move outward perpendicular to the beam.

The STAR researchers suspected there might be another explanation.

Electric Charge Provides a Test

The team found a way to investigate the mystery by taking advantage of another property of valence quarks: electric charge. Scientists compared the net baryon number measured in different RHIC nuclear collisions with the way electric charge was redistributed in those same events.

"Measuring the electric charge coming out perpendicular to the collision gives you a definitive way of measuring how many quarks are stopped and transformed into new particles," said Zebo Tang, a professor at the University of Science and Technology of China who led a group of students performing data analyses and model simulations.

The comparison revealed a striking mismatch. Researchers observed roughly twice as many baryons as should have been produced based on the electric charge associated with stopped quarks.

According to models based on QCD, that means too few quarks were being stopped to account for all the baryons appearing in the detector.

That left an important question: What was carrying the extra baryon number?

The STAR physicists argue that gluons offer a possible answer, specifically the three-pronged gluon junction that connects the proton's valence quarks.

How the Gluon Junction Could Carry Baryon Number

The proposed mechanism depends on what happens when protons inside colliding nuclei reach enormous energies. According to the STAR team, the "gluon junction" or "baryon junction" that links the quarks may be much easier to stop in a collision than the three quarks themselves.

If the junction is stopped, its energy can be converted into newly produced baryons that travel outward in directions perpendicular to the beams. Meanwhile, the valence quarks that were previously connected by the junction can continue moving forward along the beampipe.

Understanding why requires looking at the changing internal structure of a proton as its energy increases.

"The baryon junction is always there even as protons are accelerated to higher and higher energy," Prithwish Tribedy, a STAR physicist at Brookhaven Lab. "But at high energy, gluons within the proton split and multiply."

As the number of gluons increases, the proton's momentum becomes spread among more of them. Each individual gluon, including those forming the junction, therefore carries a smaller portion of the proton's total momentum. The valence quarks, however, continue to carry much of the proton's forward motion.

As a result, when the collision occurs, the comparatively slower three-pronged gluon junction should be easier to stop and convert into new particles than the rapidly moving quarks.

Stopping one connected structure is also simpler than stopping three separate quarks, making such an interaction more likely, according to Tribedy.

"In the collision, the baryon junction gets held behind, and the quarks continue on," he noted.

Building New Particles After the Collision

Quarks and gluons cannot remain isolated, so after the collision they quickly combine with other particles.

In a simplified example, a quark continuing down the beampipe could join with an antiquark and form a two-quark particle called a meson. At the same time, the three-pronged gluon junction could behave somewhat like a Y-shaped magnet, drawing in three newly created quarks from the vacuum and producing a new baryon.

Actual RHIC collisions are considerably more violent and complex.

"Even though we start with nuclei that contain roughly 100 protons and 100 neutrons, these collisions create thousands of new particles; 99% of the energy is transformed into new particles," said Rongrong Ma, a Brookhaven Lab physicist.

The STAR team found that collisions producing larger numbers of particles also showed a greater excess of "midrapidity" baryons compared with predictions based on the simpler picture in which quarks alone carry baryon number.

The fact that so many of these baryons emerge perpendicular to the beamline provides strong evidence, according to the researchers, that the baryon junction exists and plays an important role in transporting baryon number.

Rethinking a Fundamental Property of Matter

The results suggest that one of the proton's defining quantum properties may not reside solely in its three valence quarks. Instead, the gluon structure connecting those quarks could be central to how baryon number is carried through energetic collisions.

"Our research challenges the long-held idea that baryon number is simply divided among and carried by the three quarks," said Ma. "This new understanding reshapes how we think about the structure of matter and deepens our knowledge of the most fundamental element that is responsible for the universe in its current form."

The research was supported by the DOE Office of Science, the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF), and numerous international agencies and organizations listed in the scientific paper. Researchers also used the Open Science Grid, which is supported directly by NSF, along with computing resources at Brookhaven Lab's Scientific Data and Computing Facilities and the National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center (NERSC), another DOE Office of Science user facility located at DOE's Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory.

"But if we look at details inside, there are not only three quarks but also a lot of gluons interacting, connecting between those quarks, and there are also quarks and antiquarks that pop up from the vacuum, so it's actually a really complex object."

sentences.en: "In the naïve quark model, there are three quarks inside a proton, but nothing else," said Tommy Tsang, formerly a postdoc at Kent State University, now at DOE's Argonne National Laboratory.
sentences.zh: “在朴素夸克模型中，质子内部只有三个夸克，除此之外没有其他夸克，”前肯特州立大学博士后、现供职于美国能源部阿贡国家实验室的汤米·曾 (Tommy Tsang) 说。

sentences.en: "But if we look at details inside, there are not only three quarks but also a lot of gluons interacting, connecting between those quarks, and there are also quarks and antiquarks that pop up from the vacuum, so it's actually a really complex object."
sentences.zh: “但如果我们看看里面的细节，不仅有三个夸克，还有很多胶子相互作用，在这些夸克之间连接，还有从真空中弹出的夸克和反夸克，所以它实际上是一个非常复杂的物体。”

blocks.html_en: Quantum chromodynamics (QCD), the theory used to describe these interactions, has been highly successful in explaining the strong force that acts among quarks and gluons. Even so, models inspired by QCD often need additional assumptions to reproduce some of the particle patterns observed when RHIC smashes nuclei together at nearly the speed of light.

sentences.en: Quantum chromodynamics (QCD), the theory used to describe these interactions, has been highly successful in explaining the strong force that acts among quarks and gluons.
sentences.zh: 量子色动力学（QCD）是用于描述这些相互作用的理论，在解释夸克和胶子之间作用的强力方面非常成功。

sentences.en: Even so, models inspired by QCD often need additional assumptions to reproduce some of the particle patterns observed when RHIC smashes nuclei together at nearly the speed of light.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，受 QCD 启发的模型通常需要额外的假设来重现 RHIC 以接近光速粉碎原子核时观察到的一些粒子模式。

blocks.html_en: An Unexpected Excess of Baryons

sentences.en: An Unexpected Excess of Baryons
sentences.zh: 意外过量的重子

blocks.html_en: One observation in particular caught the STAR team's attention. The detector repeatedly records more baryons than antibaryons emerging sideways from the collisions, perpendicular to the direction of the incoming beams.

sentences.en: One observation in particular caught the STAR team's attention.
sentences.zh: 一项观察结果特别引起了 STAR 团队的注意。

sentences.en: The detector repeatedly records more baryons than antibaryons emerging sideways from the collisions, perpendicular to the direction of the incoming beams.
sentences.zh: 探测器反复记录到的重子数量多于碰撞中从侧面出现的反重子数量，垂直于入射光束的方向。

blocks.html_en: "In the STAR detector, we consistently see an excess of baryons coming out of the collisions perpendicular to the direction of the colliding beams," Tsang said. "The fact that we end up with more baryons than antibaryons -- or more matter than antimatter -- is not surprising since our collisions start with matter," he said.

sentences.en: "In the STAR detector, we consistently see an excess of baryons coming out of the collisions perpendicular to the direction of the colliding beams," Tsang said.
sentences.zh: “在 STAR 探测器中，我们始终看到过量的重子从垂直于碰撞光束方向的碰撞中出来，”曾说。

sentences.en: "The fact that we end up with more baryons than antibaryons -- or more matter than antimatter -- is not surprising since our collisions start with matter," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我们最终得到的重子比反重子多，或者说物质比反物质多，这一事实并不奇怪，因为我们的碰撞是从物质开始的。”

blocks.html_en: These extremely energetic collisions convert tremendous amounts of energy into thousands of newly created particles. What puzzled the researchers was not simply that more baryons than antibaryons were produced. It was where the excess baryons appeared.

sentences.en: These extremely energetic collisions convert tremendous amounts of energy into thousands of newly created particles.
sentences.zh: 这些极其高能的碰撞将巨大的能量转化为数千个新产生的粒子。

sentences.en: What puzzled the researchers was not simply that more baryons than antibaryons were produced.
sentences.zh: 让研究人员感到困惑的不仅仅是产生的重子多于反重子。

sentences.en: It was where the excess baryons appeared.
sentences.zh: 这是多余重子出现的地方。

blocks.html_en: If valence quarks alone carried the baryon number, explaining the excess away from the beamline would require all three valence quarks from one colliding proton to stop near the center of the detector. They would then have to undergo a conversion from matter into energy and back into matter, producing new baryons that move outward perpendicular to the beam.

sentences.en: If valence quarks alone carried the baryon number, explaining the excess away from the beamline would require all three valence quarks from one colliding proton to stop near the center of the detector.
sentences.zh: 如果价夸克单独携带重子数，解释远离光束线的多余部分将需要来自一个碰撞质子的所有三个价夸克停止在探测器中心附近。

sentences.en: They would then have to undergo a conversion from matter into energy and back into matter, producing new baryons that move outward perpendicular to the beam.
sentences.zh: 然后它们必须经历从物质到能量再回到物质的转换，产生垂直于光束向外移动的新重子。

blocks.html_en: The STAR researchers suspected there might be another explanation.

sentences.en: The STAR researchers suspected there might be another explanation.
sentences.zh: STAR 研究人员怀疑可能还有另一种解释。

blocks.html_en: Electric Charge Provides a Test

sentences.en: Electric Charge Provides a Test
sentences.zh: 电荷提供了一种测试

blocks.html_en: The team found a way to investigate the mystery by taking advantage of another property of valence quarks: electric charge. Scientists compared the net baryon number measured in different RHIC nuclear collisions with the way electric charge was redistributed in those same events.

sentences.en: The team found a way to investigate the mystery by taking advantage of another property of valence quarks: electric charge.
sentences.zh: 研究小组找到了一种方法，利用价夸克的另一个特性：电荷来调查这个谜团。

sentences.en: Scientists compared the net baryon number measured in different RHIC nuclear collisions with the way electric charge was redistributed in those same events.
sentences.zh: 科学家将不同 RHIC 核碰撞中测得的净重子数与这些相同事件中电荷重新分布的方式进行了比较。

blocks.html_en: "Measuring the electric charge coming out perpendicular to the collision gives you a definitive way of measuring how many quarks are stopped and transformed into new particles," said Zebo Tang, a professor at the University of Science and Technology of China who led a group of students performing data analyses and model simulations.

sentences.en: "Measuring the electric charge coming out perpendicular to the collision gives you a definitive way of measuring how many quarks are stopped and transformed into new particles," said Zebo Tang, a professor at the University of Science and Technology of China who led a group of students performing data analyses and model simulations.
sentences.zh: 中国科学技术大学教授唐泽波带领学生小组进行数据分析和模型模拟，他说：“测量垂直于碰撞产生的电荷，可以为你提供一种确定的方法来测量有多少夸克被阻止并转化为新粒子。”

blocks.html_en: The comparison revealed a striking mismatch. Researchers observed roughly twice as many baryons as should have been produced based on the electric charge associated with stopped quarks.

sentences.en: The comparison revealed a striking mismatch.
sentences.zh: 比较显示出惊人的不匹配。

sentences.en: Researchers observed roughly twice as many baryons as should have been produced based on the electric charge associated with stopped quarks.
sentences.zh: 研究人员观察到，根据与停止夸克相关的电荷，应产生的重子数量大约是其两倍。

blocks.html_en: According to models based on QCD, that means too few quarks were being stopped to account for all the baryons appearing in the detector.

sentences.en: According to models based on QCD, that means too few quarks were being stopped to account for all the baryons appearing in the detector.
sentences.zh: 根据基于 QCD 的模型，这意味着被阻止的夸克太少，无法解释探测器中出现的所有重子。

blocks.html_en: That left an important question: What was carrying the extra baryon number?

sentences.en: That left an important question: What was carrying the extra baryon number?
sentences.zh: 这就留下了一个重要的问题：什么携带着额外的重子数？

blocks.html_en: The STAR physicists argue that gluons offer a possible answer, specifically the three-pronged gluon junction that connects the proton's valence quarks.

sentences.en: The STAR physicists argue that gluons offer a possible answer, specifically the three-pronged gluon junction that connects the proton's valence quarks.
sentences.zh: STAR 物理学家认为，胶子提供了一个可能的答案，特别是连接质子价夸克的三管齐下的胶子结。

blocks.html_en: How the Gluon Junction Could Carry Baryon Number

sentences.en: How the Gluon Junction Could Carry Baryon Number
sentences.zh: 胶子结如何携带重子数

blocks.html_en: The proposed mechanism depends on what happens when protons inside colliding nuclei reach enormous energies. According to the STAR team, the "gluon junction" or "baryon junction" that links the quarks may be much easier to stop in a collision than the three quarks themselves.

sentences.en: The proposed mechanism depends on what happens when protons inside colliding nuclei reach enormous energies.
sentences.zh: 所提出的机制取决于当碰撞原子核内的质子达到巨大能量时会发生什么。

sentences.en: According to the STAR team, the "gluon junction" or "baryon junction" that links the quarks may be much easier to stop in a collision than the three quarks themselves.
sentences.zh: 据STAR团队称，连接夸克的“胶子结”或“重子结”可能比三个夸克本身更容易在碰撞中停止。

blocks.html_en: If the junction is stopped, its energy can be converted into newly produced baryons that travel outward in directions perpendicular to the beams. Meanwhile, the valence quarks that were previously connected by the junction can continue moving forward along the beampipe.

sentences.en: If the junction is stopped, its energy can be converted into newly produced baryons that travel outward in directions perpendicular to the beams.
sentences.zh: 如果结停止，它的能量可以转化为新产生的重子，这些重子沿垂直于光束的方向向外传播。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the valence quarks that were previously connected by the junction can continue moving forward along the beampipe.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，先前通过结点相连的价夸克可以继续沿着束流管向前移动。

blocks.html_en: Understanding why requires looking at the changing internal structure of a proton as its energy increases.

sentences.en: Understanding why requires looking at the changing internal structure of a proton as its energy increases.
sentences.zh: 要理解其中的原因，需要观察质子的内部结构随着其能量的增加而发生的变化。

blocks.html_en: "The baryon junction is always there even as protons are accelerated to higher and higher energy," Prithwish Tribedy, a STAR physicist at Brookhaven Lab. "But at high energy, gluons within the proton split and multiply."

sentences.en: "The baryon junction is always there even as protons are accelerated to higher and higher energy," Prithwish Tribedy, a STAR physicist at Brookhaven Lab.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克海文实验室的 STAR 物理学家 Prithwish Tribedy 表示：“即使质子被加速到越来越高的能量，重子结也始终存在。”

sentences.en: "But at high energy, gluons within the proton split and multiply."
sentences.zh: “但在高能量下，质子内的胶子会分裂并倍增。”

blocks.html_en: As the number of gluons increases, the proton's momentum becomes spread among more of them. Each individual gluon, including those forming the junction, therefore carries a smaller portion of the proton's total momentum. The valence quarks, however, continue to carry much of the proton's forward motion.

sentences.en: As the number of gluons increases, the proton's momentum becomes spread among more of them.
sentences.zh: 随着胶子数量的增加，质子的动量会分散到更多的胶子中。

sentences.en: Each individual gluon, including those forming the junction, therefore carries a smaller portion of the proton's total momentum.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个单独的胶子，包括形成结的胶子，都携带质子总动量的一小部分。

sentences.en: The valence quarks, however, continue to carry much of the proton's forward motion.
sentences.zh: 然而，价夸克继续承载着质子的大部分向前运动。

blocks.html_en: As a result, when the collision occurs, the comparatively slower three-pronged gluon junction should be easier to stop and convert into new particles than the rapidly moving quarks.

sentences.en: As a result, when the collision occurs, the comparatively slower three-pronged gluon junction should be easier to stop and convert into new particles than the rapidly moving quarks.
sentences.zh: 因此，当碰撞发生时，相对较慢的三叉胶子结应该比快速移动的夸克更容易停止并转化为新粒子。

blocks.html_en: Stopping one connected structure is also simpler than stopping three separate quarks, making such an interaction more likely, according to Tribedy.

sentences.en: Stopping one connected structure is also simpler than stopping three separate quarks, making such an interaction more likely, according to Tribedy.
sentences.zh: 特里贝迪表示，停止一个连接的结构也比停止三个独立的夸克更简单，从而使这种相互作用更有可能发生。

blocks.html_en: "In the collision, the baryon junction gets held behind, and the quarks continue on," he noted.

sentences.en: "In the collision, the baryon junction gets held behind, and the quarks continue on," he noted.
sentences.zh: “在碰撞中，重子结被阻挡在后面，夸克继续前进，”他指出。

blocks.html_en: Building New Particles After the Collision

sentences.en: Building New Particles After the Collision
sentences.zh: 碰撞后构建新粒子

blocks.html_en: Quarks and gluons cannot remain isolated, so after the collision they quickly combine with other particles.

sentences.en: Quarks and gluons cannot remain isolated, so after the collision they quickly combine with other particles.
sentences.zh: 夸克和胶子不能保持孤立状态，因此碰撞后它们会迅速与其他粒子结合。

blocks.html_en: In a simplified example, a quark continuing down the beampipe could join with an antiquark and form a two-quark particle called a meson. At the same time, the three-pronged gluon junction could behave somewhat like a Y-shaped magnet, drawing in three newly created quarks from the vacuum and producing a new baryon.

sentences.en: In a simplified example, a quark continuing down the beampipe could join with an antiquark and form a two-quark particle called a meson.
sentences.zh: 在一个简化的例子中，沿着束流管继续延伸的夸克可以与反夸克结合并形成称为介子的双夸克粒子。

sentences.en: At the same time, the three-pronged gluon junction could behave somewhat like a Y-shaped magnet, drawing in three newly created quarks from the vacuum and producing a new baryon.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，三管齐下的胶子结的行为有点像Y形磁铁，从真空中吸入三个新产生的夸克并产生一个新的重子。

blocks.html_en: Actual RHIC collisions are considerably more violent and complex.

sentences.en: Actual RHIC collisions are considerably more violent and complex.
sentences.zh: 实际的 RHIC 碰撞要剧烈且复杂得多。

blocks.html_en: "Even though we start with nuclei that contain roughly 100 protons and 100 neutrons, these collisions create thousands of new particles; 99% of the energy is transformed into new particles," said Rongrong Ma, a Brookhaven Lab physicist.

sentences.en: "Even though we start with nuclei that contain roughly 100 protons and 100 neutrons, these collisions create thousands of new particles; 99% of the energy is transformed into new particles," said Rongrong Ma, a Brookhaven Lab physicist.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克海文实验室物理学家 Rongrong Ma 表示：“即使我们从包含大约 100 个质子和 100 个中子的原子核开始，这些碰撞也会产生数千个新粒子；99% 的能量都转化为新粒子。”

blocks.html_en: The STAR team found that collisions producing larger numbers of particles also showed a greater excess of "midrapidity" baryons compared with predictions based on the simpler picture in which quarks alone carry baryon number.

sentences.en: The STAR team found that collisions producing larger numbers of particles also showed a greater excess of "midrapidity" baryons compared with predictions based on the simpler picture in which quarks alone carry baryon number.
sentences.zh: STAR团队发现，与基于夸克单独携带重子数的简单图像的预测相比，产生大量粒子的碰撞也显示出更多的“中速”重子。

blocks.html_en: The fact that so many of these baryons emerge perpendicular to the beamline provides strong evidence, according to the researchers, that the baryon junction exists and plays an important role in transporting baryon number.

sentences.en: The fact that so many of these baryons emerge perpendicular to the beamline provides strong evidence, according to the researchers, that the baryon junction exists and plays an important role in transporting baryon number.
sentences.zh: 研究人员表示，如此多的重子垂直于束线出现，这一事实提供了强有力的证据，证明重子结的存在并在传输重子数方面发挥着重要作用。

blocks.html_en: Rethinking a Fundamental Property of Matter

sentences.en: Rethinking a Fundamental Property of Matter
sentences.zh: 重新思考物质的基本属性

blocks.html_en: The results suggest that one of the proton's defining quantum properties may not reside solely in its three valence quarks. Instead, the gluon structure connecting those quarks could be central to how baryon number is carried through energetic collisions.

sentences.en: The results suggest that one of the proton's defining quantum properties may not reside solely in its three valence quarks.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，质子的定义量子特性之一可能不仅仅存在于其三价夸克中。

sentences.en: Instead, the gluon structure connecting those quarks could be central to how baryon number is carried through energetic collisions.
sentences.zh: 相反，连接这些夸克的胶子结构可能是重子数如何通过高能碰撞传递的核心。

blocks.html_en: "Our research challenges the long-held idea that baryon number is simply divided among and carried by the three quarks," said Ma. "This new understanding reshapes how we think about the structure of matter and deepens our knowledge of the most fundamental element that is responsible for the universe in its current form."

sentences.en: "Our research challenges the long-held idea that baryon number is simply divided among and carried by the three quarks," said Ma.
sentences.zh: 马说：“我们的研究挑战了长期以来的观念，即重子数只是由三个夸克划分并由三个夸克携带。”

sentences.en: "This new understanding reshapes how we think about the structure of matter and deepens our knowledge of the most fundamental element that is responsible for the universe in its current form."
sentences.zh: “这种新的理解重塑了我们对物质结构的看法，并加深了我们对构成宇宙当前形式的最基本元素的了解。”

content_html_zh:
相对论重离子对撞机 (RHIC) STAR 探测器的新发现正在挑战人们所熟悉的质子定义量子特性之一的图景。 结果表明，胶子（将夸克粘合在一起的胶水粒子）可能在携带和保存重子数方面发挥关键作用。

证据来自 RHIC 的高能粒子碰撞，RHIC 是美国能源部 (DOE) 科学办公室核物理研究用户设施，于 2000 年至 2026 年初在 DOE 布鲁克海文国家实验室运行。 根据发表在《科学》杂志上的这项新研究，重子数可能与连接质子的三个主要夸克的 Y 形胶子“接头”有关。 如果得到证实，这将挑战长期以来的假设，即重子数只属于这些夸克。

“传统上，科学家们假设质子或中子内的三个主要‘价’夸克中的每一个都携带三分之一的重子数，”布鲁克海文实验室联合任命的肯特州立大学教授徐章步说。

关于胶子的数十年历史的想法

物理学家在 20 世纪 70 年代首次提出重子结，也称为胶子结，作为描述胶子如何连接质子内部价夸克的一种方式。 1996 年，即 RHIC 开始运行的四年前，石溪大学和布鲁克海文实验室的理论物理学家 Dmitri Kharzeev 提出，这个连接可能会做一些更根本的事情。 负有重子数的不是价夸克，而是结本身。

STAR 合作现已开发出一种方法，利用 RHIC 产生的几种类型的碰撞来测试这种可能性。

“使用从 RHIC 不同类型的粒子碰撞收集的数据，我们的结果表明重子数不仅仅由单个夸克携带，”徐补充道。 “我们的研究结果强烈支持这样的观点，即当以这种特殊的结构排列时，胶子（将夸克结合在一起的粒子）更容易携带和传输重子数。”

为什么重子数很重要

确定什么实际上携带重子数的问题远远超出了质子的内部结构。 在RHIC碰撞中，重子数守恒意味着重子、质子、中子等三夸克粒子的总数在碰撞前后必须保持不变。 同样的守恒定律也适用于宇宙尺度。

莱斯大学的 STAR 物理学家 Nicole Lewis 于 2020 年在布鲁克海文实验室作为博士后启动了这个项目，她说：“自大爆炸以来，质子和中子的数量总和从未随时间变化。” “这种保护的原因尚不清楚。 这是宇宙的奥秘之一，与为什么我们拥有的物质多于反物质有关，”她说。

重子数守恒也有一个更明显的结果。 它有助于解释质子的非凡稳定性，质子构成原子核的核心部分，在正常情况下似乎不会衰变。

“人们相信质子的寿命比宇宙的寿命还要长，”刘易斯说。 “这使得原子核能够形成并保持稳定——这意味着当我们在宇宙中与物质相互作用时，物质可以存在。”

更复杂的质子

胶子携带重子数的可能性将推翻许多教科书中的标准简化描述。 在这张图中，质子的重子数为+1，平均分配给它的三个主要价夸克。 因此，每个夸克携带着三分之一的重子数，就像质子的电荷分布在它的三个价夸克之间一样。

但真正的质子比简化模型显示的要复杂得多。

“在朴素夸克模型中，质子内部只有三个夸克，除此之外没有其他夸克，”前肯特州立大学博士后、现供职于美国能源部阿贡国家实验室的汤米·曾 (Tommy Tsang) 说。 “但如果我们看看里面的细节，不仅有三个夸克，还有很多胶子相互作用，在这些夸克之间连接，还有从真空中弹出的夸克和反夸克，所以它实际上是一个非常复杂的物体。”

量子色动力学（QCD）是用于描述这些相互作用的理论，在解释夸克和胶子之间作用的强力方面非常成功。 即便如此，受 QCD 启发的模型通常需要额外的假设来重现 RHIC 以接近光速粉碎原子核时观察到的一些粒子模式。

意外过量的重子

一项观察结果特别引起了 STAR 团队的注意。 探测器反复记录到的重子数量多于碰撞中从侧面出现的反重子数量，垂直于入射光束的方向。

“在 STAR 探测器中，我们始终看到过量的重子从垂直于碰撞光束方向的碰撞中出来，”曾说。 他说：“我们最终得到的重子比反重子多，或者说物质比反物质多，这一事实并不奇怪，因为我们的碰撞是从物质开始的。”

这些极其高能的碰撞将巨大的能量转化为数千个新产生的粒子。 让研究人员感到困惑的不仅仅是产生的重子多于反重子。 这是多余重子出现的地方。

如果价夸克单独携带重子数，解释远离光束线的多余部分将需要来自一个碰撞质子的所有三个价夸克停止在探测器中心附近。 然后它们必须经历从物质到能量再回到物质的转换，产生垂直于光束向外移动的新重子。

STAR 研究人员怀疑可能还有另一种解释。

电荷提供了一种测试

研究小组找到了一种方法，利用价夸克的另一个特性：电荷来调查这个谜团。 科学家将不同 RHIC 核碰撞中测得的净重子数与这些相同事件中电荷重新分布的方式进行了比较。

中国科学技术大学教授唐泽波带领学生小组进行数据分析和模型模拟，他说：“测量垂直于碰撞产生的电荷，可以为你提供一种确定的方法来测量有多少夸克被阻止并转化为新粒子。”

比较显示出惊人的不匹配。 研究人员观察到，根据与停止夸克相关的电荷，应产生的重子数量大约是其两倍。

根据基于 QCD 的模型，这意味着被阻止的夸克太少，无法解释探测器中出现的所有重子。

这就留下了一个重要的问题：什么携带着额外的重子数？

STAR 物理学家认为，胶子提供了一个可能的答案，特别是连接质子价夸克的三管齐下的胶子结。

胶子结如何携带重子数

所提出的机制取决于当碰撞原子核内的质子达到巨大能量时会发生什么。 据STAR团队称，连接夸克的“胶子结”或“重子结”可能比三个夸克本身更容易在碰撞中停止。

如果结停止，它的能量可以转化为新产生的重子，这些重子沿垂直于光束的方向向外传播。 与此同时，先前通过结点相连的价夸克可以继续沿着束流管向前移动。

要理解其中的原因，需要观察质子的内部结构随着其能量的增加而发生的变化。

布鲁克海文实验室的 STAR 物理学家 Prithwish Tribedy 表示：“即使质子被加速到越来越高的能量，重子结也始终存在。” “但在高能量下，质子内的胶子会分裂并倍增。”

随着胶子数量的增加，质子的动量会分散到更多的胶子中。 因此，每个单独的胶子，包括形成结的胶子，都携带质子总动量的一小部分。 然而，价夸克继续承载着质子的大部分向前运动。

因此，当碰撞发生时，相对较慢的三叉胶子结应该比快速移动的夸克更容易停止并转化为新粒子。

特里贝迪表示，停止一个连接的结构也比停止三个独立的夸克更简单，从而使这种相互作用更有可能发生。

“在碰撞中，重子结被阻挡在后面，夸克继续前进，”他指出。

碰撞后构建新粒子

夸克和胶子不能保持孤立状态，因此碰撞后它们会迅速与其他粒子结合。

在一个简化的例子中，沿着束流管继续延伸的夸克可以与反夸克结合并形成称为介子的双夸克粒子。 与此同时，三管齐下的胶子结的行为有点像Y形磁铁，从真空中吸入三个新产生的夸克并产生一个新的重子。

实际的 RHIC 碰撞要剧烈且复杂得多。

布鲁克海文实验室物理学家 Rongrong Ma 表示：“即使我们从包含大约 100 个质子和 100 个中子的原子核开始，这些碰撞也会产生数千个新粒子；99% 的能量都转化为新粒子。”

STAR团队发现，与基于夸克单独携带重子数的简单图像的预测相比，产生大量粒子的碰撞也显示出更多的“中速”重子。

研究人员表示，如此多的重子垂直于束线出现，这一事实提供了强有力的证据，证明重子结的存在并在传输重子数方面发挥着重要作用。

重新思考物质的基本属性

结果表明，质子的定义量子特性之一可能不仅仅存在于其三价夸克中。 相反，连接这些夸克的胶子结构可能是重子数如何通过高能碰撞传递的核心。

马说：“我们的研究挑战了长期以来的观念，即重子数只是由三个夸克划分并由三个夸克携带。” “这种新的理解重塑了我们对物质结构的看法，并加深了我们对构成宇宙当前形式的最基本元素的了解。”
